data.one_liner: A Flutter video player built on video_player with advanced features like playlists, subtitles, and PiP.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable video player widget with support for HLS, DASH, multiple audio/subtitle tracks, caching, and picture‑in‑picture. It adds higher‑level controls and configuration on top of the base video_player plugin.
use_when: You need out‑of‑the‑box features such as playlists, subtitles, or PiP without building them yourself
You want a drop‑in replacement for video_player with richer UI controls
avoid_when: You only need simple playback and want the smallest possible dependency
You require a fully custom UI that diverges heavily from the provided controls
strengths: Rich feature set (subtitles, multiple tracks, caching, PiP)
Customizable Material & Cupertino controls via separate UI packages
Active maintenance with recent SDK updates
weaknesses: Adds several transitive dependencies (material_ui, cupertino_ui, wakelock_plus) increasing app size
Breaking changes between major versions may require code migration
Relies on video_player, so underlying platform bugs still propagate
data.setup_notes: Add better_player_plus to pubspec, ensure Android minSdk >=21 and iOS deployment target >=15. No additional native code beyond video_player's requirements, but may need permissions for storage if caching is used.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight core player without extra UI or feature overhead
